sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:40

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:40:1
items.html: Dross relative to the world of Atzilut, and all these phases go out in the secret of the blood of birth: For they were not corrected in Atzilut, except from the phase of the faces of the ZAT of Nekudim; but from the phase of their posterior they could not be corrected in Atzilut, as above in Part 11. And since the entire phase of Atzilut within them was sorted, the remainders are reckoned as waste that is no longer of any use, relative to Atzilut, and therefore they go out in the secret of the blood of birth. However, relative to BYA, they are not reckoned as complete waste, for there is still found in them phases of holiness to be sorted, needed for the Partzufim of BYA, as is written before us.
